text:
maya: Heads-up — customer in eu-west reported intermittent 503s hitting /v1/generate. Anyone have a saved logsearch I can run to slice by org/model/route/region/status? Need quick filter to attach to the incident ticket.

obs-bot: Alert: 5xx rate increased for route /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (last 5m).

samir: Quick one you can paste into Log Search. Filters: org, model, route, region, status (500-599). Example: 
```
service:api AND route:\"/v1/generate\" AND region:\"eu-west-1\" AND model:\"redwood-7b-v1\" AND status:[500 TO 599] | sort desc @timestamp
```
Save it as: "EU | /v1/generate | 5xx by org" and then add an org filter like `org_id:12345` when you open it.

eli: Also add `headers.request_id` to the columns so you can jump to traces. If you need a trace link use: https://console.redwood.dev/traces?service=api&query=route%3D%22%2Fv1%2Fgenerate%22%20region%3Deu-west-1

jess: Dashboards: Observability -> Routes -> /v1/generate (quick link) https://console.redwood.dev/d/observability/routes?panelId=7&org=redwood (will show 5xx rate over time and top orgs). Saved searches live under Log Search -> Saved Views -> "Team: eng-sre".

samir: If this is noisy we should tweak the alert. Current alert fires on >5% 5xx rate over 5m. We can change to 10% or widen to 10m window. I can update the rule if you want — ping me with the incident ID.

maya: Thanks — I created the saved view (EU | /v1/generate | 5xx by org) and linked it in INC-2026. Added `org_id:12345` and a sample request_id. Marking this as triaged for now. :white_check_mark:

eli: If we see the same across other regions, run the same query but replace region:\"eu-west-1\" with region:\"us-west-2\" and model filter with `model:\"redwood-ggml-13b\"` as needed.

maya: Cool — will follow up if it reappears. Thanks everyone! :pray:
